ExcludedModules.description: List of module names to exclude from updates and pruning

PinnedModules.description: Modules held at a specific version. The pinned version is installed if missing, and pruning keeps it instead of the newest version. A module listed in ExcludedModules is skipped entirely and its pin is ignored.

additionalProperties.description: Exact version to hold, optionally with a prerelease label (e.g. 2.19.0 or 2.0.0-beta1)

LogRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain log files before automatic cleanup

TrustPSGallery.description: Whether to trust PSGallery repository during updates

NotificationMode.description: When to show Windows toast notifications: Always, OnFailure, or Never

ModuleUpdateTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single module update before timing out and moving to the next module. Prevents one slow module (e.g. Microsoft.Graph) from consuming all scheduled task time.
